q1_toolchain_usable.evidence: Install(3/3 pass), Bootstrap(READY), Preflight(3/3 fixtures PASS), PhaseClose(match=3ok, mismatch=caught, no-verifier=warned), E2E(ALL_PASS)

q2_still_hard.question: What is still hard for users?
q2_still_hard.answer: Path management (SourcePath, TargetPath), no copy-paste examples in QUICKSTART, no meta-script for full chain
q2_still_hard.recommendation: P6 usability polish: auto-detect paths, copy-paste examples, optional factory.ps1 meta-script

q3_release_readiness.recommendation: RELEASE-READINESS-0 audit next if user wants; v0.5 remains BLOCKED
